CommunityApplications.Profile: SeerrNG is a Seerr fork for requests across movies, TV, music, books, comics, magazines, ROMs, and PC games. This repository provides one Unraid Community Applications listing and template for SeerrNG. Its optional integrations include Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, BookshelfNG, Chaptarr, Mylar3, Kapowarr, LazyLibrarian, ROMarrNG, and QuestarrNG.
